data.name: Norma
data.description: Norma is a Paris-based climate tech startup building a novel Direct Air Capture system that combines supercapacitor energy storage with electrochemical CO2 capture in a single device, aiming for 10× lower energy consumption and sub-$100/ton costs. The company is backed by Counteract VC and Marble, has raised a $1M pre-seed round, and secured its first customer through the Milkywire Climate Transformation Fund. It plans a container-sized pilot in 2026 and a full-scale plant by 2029.
